title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

As a senior full-stack engineer on our product and AI team, you’ll build new tools and experiences that give entrepreneurs real leverage — from conversational business planning to smart funding recommendations, automated documents, and personalized dashboards.


You’ll work directly with the founder and a tight product/design team. No bureaucracy. No layers. Just building, shipping fast, and seeing your work used by hundreds of thousands of people.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
READ ME: To be considered for this role, please read the full post. Due to demand, we only review candidates who email with the requested details at the bottom. LinkedIn “Easy Apply” submissions will not be reviewed.


About Skip

Skip helps millions of entrepreneurs and small business owners access funding, grow faster, and build real businesses — all in one place. Our revenue is comparable to a high-growth Series B company and has doubled in the past two months. Over 1 million business owners trust Skip to simplify what used to be a maze of red tape.


Now we’re building the next evolution of entrepreneurship: an AI Cofounder that helps anyone start, run, and scale a business.


If you want to work on a product that touches real people — and directly helps them build their livelihoods — Skip is one of the most impactful places you can be.


The Role

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity engineering role.


As a senior full-stack engineer on our product and AI team, you’ll build new tools and experiences that give entrepreneurs real leverage — from conversational business planning to smart funding recommendations, automated documents, and personalized dashboards.


You’ll work directly with the founder and a tight product/design team. No bureaucracy. No layers. Just building, shipping fast, and seeing your work used by hundreds of thousands of people.


What You'll Do:

  • Build and ship new features using modern web technologies and AI APIs.
  • Integrate AI into user-facing flows — conversational builders, assistants, recommendations.
  • Contribute across Skip’s product stack: React/Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Supabase.
  • Rapidly prototype, test with real users, and iterate based on data and feedback.
  • Work closely with product, design, and support to uncover what actually moves the needle.
  • Help shape the architecture and UX of Skip’s AI Cofounder product.
  • (Optional/Secondary) Explore RAG, embeddings, or personalization systems — only if interested.


About You:

  • 5+ years of engineering experience , with strong experience shipping production features.
  • Strong with TypeScript and React/Next.js .
  • Comfortable across the stack or eager to work full-stack.
  • Curious about AI and excited to integrate AI capabilities into real products.
  • Communicative, proactive, and collaborative — you’re comfortable working closely with product and design.
  • You care about impact: you want your work to help real entrepreneurs build real businesses.


Why Join Skip?

  • You’ll be one of the core engineers shaping Skip’s AI Cofounder — a generational product shift.
  • You’ll work with an inspiring, high-output engineering/design team (including a strong Brazil engineering team).
  • You’ll have real ownership — not a feature factory, not endless specs.
  • You’ll see the impact of your work directly: from solo founders to growing teams across the U.S.
  • You’ll ship fast and learn fast.


Compensation:

  • Base Salary: $60,000–$80,000 USD equivalent (paid in USD or BRL)
  • Equity: 0.10%–0.40% — meaningful ownership in a fast-growing company
  • Paid time off + remote-first + autonomy to do your best work


How to Apply


Email:

Subject: Senior Software Engineer Position


Before emailing take a look through Skip including and share in 2-3 sentences why Skip's mission resonates with you and what's most important to you in your next role. You'll get a reply with next steps. We review all applications manually — no LinkedIn black hole.


We're building the future of entrepreneurship. Join us.

title: Especialista Engenharia Mobile (React Native)
description:
Organização de grande porte busca profissional com sólida experiência técnica para liderar uma equipe de desenvolvimento focada em aplicações móveis React Native. O desafio envolve atuar como referência técnica, direcionando o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades estratégicas e promovendo a excelência do produto. O ambiente é dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Definir arquitetura e padrões de desenvolvimento para aplicações React Native, assegurando qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Orientar e desenvolver o time técnico, promovendo crescimento profissional e colaboração.
  • Interagir com outras áreas para garantir entregas eficazes e seguras.
  • Realizar revisões de código, assegurando aderência a padrões, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar na gestão de projetos, estimando prazos, acompanhando progresso e removendo obstáculos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento mobile, com foco em React Native.
  • Domínio de JavaScript, TypeScript e fundamentos de front-end.
  • Vivência com APIs RESTful e integrações back-end.
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança para desenvolvimento mobile (OWASP Mobile Top Ten).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise estática e dinâmica de código (SAST/DAST).
  • Atuação com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em NodeJS.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo Android (Java/Kotlin) ou iOS (Swift/Objective-C).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Vivência em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Contribuições para projetos open-source.


Comportamentais:

  • Liderança colaborativa e inspiradora.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva.
  • Respeito à diversidade e postura ética.
  • Humildade e responsabilidade.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and onboard world-class creative and production talent. You’ll help build the global network that powers SoCreative — sourcing videographers, photographers, designers, editors, motion specialists, creative leads, project managers, and other key roles across time zones.


This role is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys connecting great people with great opportunities. If you’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and love building strong talent pipelines, you’ll thrive here.


What you’ll do

  • Source and attract top creative, production, and operations talent across global markets
  • Manage the full recruitment cycle — from job posting to screening, interviews, assessments, and onboarding
  • Build strong talent pools for high-demand roles (design, video, motion, PM, creative leads)
  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements and refine talent profiles
  • Conduct structured interviews and evaluate candidates for skills, experience, and culture fit
  • Maintain organised, up-to-date applicant pipelines and recruitment dashboards
  • Implement scalable sourcing strategies using LinkedIn, job boards, communities, referrals, and outreach tools
  • Maintain clear, timely communication with candidates to ensure a positive experience
  • Help improve hiring processes, documentation, and workflows as we grow


What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or sourcing (creative, agency, or tech experience preferred)
  • Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with modern recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, etc.)
  • Ability to assess creative and operational talent across multiple specialties
  • Clear and confident communication in English, able to manage candidate expectations and present opportunities effectively
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple roles at once
  • A positive, collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility — powered by smart tech, streamlined systems, and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking, and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative, and help shape a modern creative operation — we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (Remote – Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote (Brazil) – São Paulo

Duration: Open-Ended


Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning solutions. In this role, you will influence the technical direction of the team, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering partners, and drive innovation across data-driven initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong technical expertise with leadership capabilities and a passion for building high-impact solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end development and deployment of Machine Learning models to solve complex business problems.
  • Write and maintain clean, efficient, scalable code following industry best practices.
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and support data-informed decision-making.
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies, including deep learning and modern frameworks, to build robust models.
  • Take ownership of key system components and influence the broader technical strategy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to design deployable, production-ready ML solutions.
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, fostering team expertise and growth.
  • Contribute to organizational technical leadership through patent filings and publications in top-tier venues.


Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning.
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML and deep learning models in production at scale.
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, pipelines, feature engineering, experiment design).
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and techniques such as gradient boosting, deep neural networks, transformers, and optimization methods.
  • Experience in Computer Vision ; experience in Causal Inference is highly desirable.
  • Expertise with Python scientific libraries (NumPy, pandas, Polars) and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn).
  • Strong data engineering skills and comfort working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark).
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Fluency in Python and SQL .


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related fields.
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail industry problems.
  • Familiarity with modern MLOps tools and pipelines .
  • Impact-driven mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience guiding or managing technical teams.

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori/Webdynpro)
description:

A atuação é voltada a projetos de desenvolvimento (novos produtos, novas funcionalidades e melhorias estruturadas), com foco em qualidade de código, performance e boa experiência do usuário.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver novas aplicações SAP Fiori/UI5 integradas ao backend ABAP, incluindo definição e implementação de serviços OData e CDS Views.
  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações em Webdynpro ABAP, criando novas telas, fluxos e funcionalidades de acordo com requisitos de negócio.
  • Implementar programas, APIs e objetos ABAP (BAPIs, BADIs, user-exits/enhancements) necessários para suportar novas soluções Fiori e Webdynpro.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) SAP ABAP Pleno, com foco em desenvolvimento (novos projetos e evolutivos), e não apenas suporte/sustentação.
  • Experiência prática com SAP Fiori/UI5 (HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, SAPUI5) e consumo/criação de serviços OData.

title: Cloud Architect
description:
About the company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to join our team.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement a secure, governed, and cost-transparent AWS Landing Zone, leveraging AWS Control Tower to establish a consistent, well-architected cloud foundation. This foundational work will support the client's future initiatives in data analytics, AI, and workload management.
  • Lead Discovery & Planning workshops.
  • Design the multi-account strategy and VPC network architecture.
  • Perform the entire Implementation (deploying Control Tower, core security services, and IaC artifacts).
  • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions.

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

We are looking for an expert-level Java/Spring Boot Specialist who can contribute to technical decisions, uphold engineering standards, and collaborate across backend and frontend components.

You will work with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and full-stack developers across complex financial and operational domains, including Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

StaffingAbroad is seeking a Principal Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer to join a #1 US-based FinTech & Crypto company . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in C#/.NET and has a strong focus on writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role Salary $5.000USD to $7.000 USD


What You Will Do

  • Develop and Maintain Applications : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/.NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.
  • Shape System Architecture : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across FinTech applications.
  • Write Quality Code : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.
  • Support Production Systems : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.
  • Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.
  • Focus on Security and Compliance : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with FinTech regulations.


What You Will Need

  • Strong Technical Expertise :
  • Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.
  • Proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).
  • Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.
  • Commitment to Software Quality :
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.
  • Experience and Education :
  • 6+ years of back-end software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
  • Collaboration and Communication :
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.
  • Cultural Fit :
  • Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in FinTech and Crypto solutions.


Plusses Include

  • Experience with iDesign architecture methodology .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, including their tools and services.

title: Linguist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing (Language: Portuguese, Location: Brazil)

Experience Level: Bachelors or Masters or PhD in Linguistics or a related field.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:


  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.

Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analytics Engineer Sênior
description:
Vaga: Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) / Analytics Engineer


A ATRA está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) para atuar na construção, organização e otimização de pipelines analíticos, modelos de transformação, governança de dados e camadas de consumo. Essa função combina engenharia, analytics e visão de produto — ideal para profissionais que transitam com fluidez entre dados, negócio e tecnologia.


Responsabilidades

  • Construir pipelines de transformação utilizando DBT com testes, documentação e boas práticas.
  • Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines complexos em Airflow.
  • Criar e otimizar estruturas em BigQuery com foco em performance e eficiência de custos.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e análises em Looker Platform, garantindo coerência entre métricas e modelos.
  • Atuar próximo a times de produto, dados e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções analíticas.
  • Garantir organização, padronização e governança das camadas de dados.
  • Automação de processos e validações utilizando Python (quando aplicável).
  • Acompanhar, investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados a dados e pipelines.
  • Documentar processos, modelos e padrões de forma clara e escalável.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a), Engenheiro(a) de BI ou função similar.
  • Domínio de SQL avançado, incluindo modelagem relacional e dimensional.
  • Experiência avançada com DBT para construção e gestão de pipelines de transformação.
  • Experiência com Airflow para orquestração de fluxos de dados.
  • GCP – BigQuery : conhecimento profundo de performance, otimização de custos e recursos avançados.
  • Familiaridade com serviços de dados do GCP (ex.: Cloud Storage).
  • Experiência com Looker Platform para criação de dashboards e análises.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis/Consultivos)

  • Perfil consultivo: capacidade de dialogar com áreas não técnicas e traduzir necessidades em soluções.
  • Pensamento analítico e crítico: habilidade para análise de causa-raiz e construção de insights.
  • Cultura forte de documentação, governança e padronização de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Python para automações e análises exploratórias.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de negócio (Opcional): AARRR, LTV, CAC, métricas financeiras.


Soft Skills

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Organização, autonomia e alto rigor técnico.
  • Visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Proatividade para propor melhorias estruturais.


Modelo de Trabalho e Contratação

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido ou Remoto (ajustável conforme projeto)


Benefícios ATRA

  • TotalPass
  • Reembolso 100% em certificações
  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas
  • Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA: Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Desenvolvedor Front-End Sênior (ReactJS)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento de tecnologia e soluções digitais , oferecendo produtos e plataformas voltadas à otimização de processos, integração de sistemas e modernização de operações corporativas. É uma empresa em crescimento, com foco em inovação, usabilidade e desenvolvimento de aplicações web de alta performance.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando ReactJS .
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis com hooks e styled-components .
  • Escrever testes automatizados com Jest, Cucumber e React Testing Library.
  • Atuar na depuração e troubleshooting de problemas front-end.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas em performance, usabilidade e arquitetura.

  • Proficiência em JavaScript , TypeScript , ReactJS (hooks) e styled-components .
  • Conhecimento em NPM/Yarn .

  • Vivência com depuração front-end e boas práticas de performance e usabilidade.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend de GenAI Pleno (BR)
description:
Você na Deloitte!



Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na organização com o portfólio de serviços profissionais mais diversificado do mundo, atuando como Desenvolvedor(a) Backend de GenAI . Na sua rotina, você irá:



  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de inferência para LLMs, incluindo pré e pós-processamento, garantindo boas práticas de Guard Rails;
  • Implementar orquestração de multi-agentes usando LangChain/LangGraph;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir integrações seguras via MCP para conectar aplicações internas, provedores de LLM e serviços de dados, garantindo conformidade e proteção de informações;
  • Desenvolvimento de buscas e otimizações de sistemas RAG em Bancos Vetoriais (ChromaDB, MilvusDB, AI Search, Pinecone);
  • Criar e instanciar containers utilizando Docker/Kubernetes e configurar o orquestrador para garantir alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade;
  • Projetar, construir, utilizar e otimizar bancos de dados PostgreSQL, garantindo modelagem eficiente, alta performance e integridade dos dados;
  • Conhecimento em gerenciamento de prompts e versionamento (Langfuse, LangSmith);
  • Conhecimento em geração de métricas de avaliação de LLM (Langfuse, deepEval);
  • Garantir práticas de CI/CD, testes automatizados e observabilidade;
  • Conhecimento de versionamento de código mantendo boas práticas (Git);
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (dados, produto, UX);
  • Contribuir para deploy e monitoramento em ambientes cloud.



Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.



Requisitos



O que precisa para você se candidatar a vaga?



  • Experiência avançada em Python e desenvolvimento backend, incluindo boas práticas e padrões de projetos, testes automatizados e otimização de código. (FastAPI, Flask, Django);
  • Conhecimento profundo em frameworks para IA generativa, especialmente LangChain e LangGraph, e familiaridade com conceitos de Orquestração de Multi-Agentes;
  • Sólida base em arquitetura de containers, com habilidade para criar imagens eficientes e configurar orquestradores para ambientes escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes;
  • Proficiência em bancos de dados relacionais, com foco em modelagem, tuning de performance e integridade em PostgreSQL;
  • Experiência com construção de ferramentas utilizando MCP (Model Context Protocol) e sistemas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) ;
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), envolvendo deploy, monitoramento e otimização de recursos. *Preferencial Azure;
  • Experiência na implementação de práticas de CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps (Azure Pipeline), incluindo configuração de pipelines, automação de testes e monitoramento para garantir qualidade e entrega contínua;
  • Experiencia com versionamento de código, utilizando melhores práticas de desenvolvimento com uso de comandos Git.



Diferenciais



  • Participação em soluções de IA ou sistemas críticos com múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Conhecimento em segurança para aplicações GenAI;
  • Certificações em cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP);
  • Certificações em IA e GenAI (Azure AI Engineer Associate ou equivalentes).
  • Escolaridade mínima: Ensino Superior - Concluído



Beneficios



O que estará disponível para você ?



Desenvolvimento profissional


É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.



Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?



Cuidados com o seu bem-estar



Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:



  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social



(Mais) Benefícios



  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão Multibenefícios*



*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.



Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil



Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.
